create_layer_skip_config: create a LayerSkipConfig to specify which transformer block indices to skip with attention and feed-forward skipping options
apply_layer_skip: apply layer skipping hooks to a transformer model module using a LayerSkipConfig to skip specified layers
configure_attention_score_skip: configure attention score skipping mode that returns value projections instead of full attention outputs
skip_transformer_blocks: skip transformer blocks by index with configurable dropout to reduce computation during inference
serialize_layer_skip_config: serialize a LayerSkipConfig to a dictionary or deserialize from a dictionary for configuration management
